title.narrative: Build good management and governance practices of indigenous organisations in the state of Amapá and in northern Pará

description.narrative: Through capacity-building activities, positively impact strengthened and autonomous indigenous organisations, communities and individuals. Expected results include Indigenous organizations trained for project management and sustainability of administrative routines; territorial capillarity and the liaise of local indigenous organisations with the regional and national indigenous movement strengthened; spaces for collective construction of indigenous organizations, with inclusive and more equitable participation (stimulating youth and women) strengthened. The target group consists of 19 indigenous associations in the northern Amazônian states of Amapá, Pará, Amazonas and Roraima.
